# Memories matching "raspberry usb power" — revision 42

### Raspberry Pi 5 USB ports share one power switch [/topics/hardware/raspberry-pi-usb-power.md]
On a Raspberry Pi 5 the USB ports cannot be power-cycled one at a time; switching power affects all of them together. Plan device resets around a powered hub with per-port switching instead.

How to apply: when the user corrects this, the agent updates the memory the same day.

### Some SSD enclosures need UAS disabled [/topics/hardware/ssd-enclosure-quirks.md]
A few USB SSD enclosures drop off the bus under load with UAS enabled. Add a usb-storage quirk for the enclosure's vendor and product id and confirm the disk stays mounted through a long copy.

How to apply: the agent follows this in every session; this memory outranks habit.
